publication.edition: English translation with introduction and notes

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the edition (Hard trans., Gill intro/notes) and that the Meditations are private philosophical exercises in Greek, characterised by short self-addressed reflections on principle and mortality rather than narrative.

limitations: Marcus' Greek is described by the translator as 'harsh, crabbed, odd or awkward'; stylistic specifics are not claimed from translation alone.

copyright.notes: Greek text public domain; translation copyrighted; no passages reproduced.
